Sheriff Buck Brady notices siblings Gladys and Harry Nestor arrive from the East and soon learns Lone Mule’s rulers, Dave Skinner and Charley Eley, have stripped them of honest work to force Gladys into Skinner’s dance hall. After Eley drunkenly menaces them, a struggle erupts; Eley is shot, and stage driver Larry Lebec spirits the terrified pair to Mohave Wells.
